scope: Before the three prospectively designated outer scores are available, complete the remaining folds 1 and 3 of exactly the same five-fold partition. This is a descriptive coverage extension. It does not alter or replace the three-fold designated-validation gate.
control: Run the same frozen source, same 64-fit cap and seed-replication mode on each remaining anonymous fold. The original pre-pilot full-data export is always saved inside this run. Use a separate predictor to reconstruct its labels. On the initial three folds require the same reconstruction to match every class from the separately cold-run ordinary arm. This saves duplicating two baseline searches. Report both the three independent-control pairs and the two within-run pairs, and whether each solves and reloads cleanly.
scoring: Bind all input, application and model hashes and seal both extra policies' predictions before reading their external training labels. Check all five held sets have disjoint whole-feature groups and cover all 8117 course training rows. Report counts, each direction and a grouped paired interval. Some training examples were used in prior research. Do not tune or open course test/H2 or designate a different research winner.
